User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the PermitFlow application.

email.description: The email address of the user.

mobile.description: The mobile phone number of the user.

role.description: The role of the user (Admin, Supervisor, SiteEngineer).

registrationRequest.description: Indicates whether the user's registration request is pending approval.

assignedProjectIds.description: References to Projects assigned to the user. (Relationship: User N:N Project)

Project.title: Project
Project.description: Represents a project in the PermitFlow application.

Site.title: Site
Site.description: Represents a site managed by admins, used in dropdowns.

name.description: The name of the site (Project name).

projectCompany.description: The company associated with the project.

acCapacity.description: The AC capacity of the site.

dcCapacity.description: The DC capacity of the site.

PtwType.title: PTW Type
PtwType.description: Represents a type of Permit to Work, used in dropdowns.

name.description: The name of the PTW type.

PermitToWork.title: PermitToWork
PermitToWork.description: Represents a Permit to Work request.

id.description: Unique identifier for the permit to work request.

descriptionOfWork.description: A description of the work to be performed.

attachments.description: An array of media files attached to the permit.

contentType.description: Content type of the media file.

name.description: The name of the media file.

commentsAndRemarks.description: Comments and remarks related to the permit.

adminRemarks.description: Remarks added by the admin during the approval/rejection process.

status.description: The status of the permit (e.g., Submitted, Approved, Rejected, Corrected).

isNew.description: Indicates if the permit is new and has not been seen by an admin/supervisor yet. Used for notification badges.

requestDate.description: Timestamp when the permit was requested.

statusChangeDate.description: Timestamp of the last status change (e.g., approval, rejection, correction).

siteEngineerId.description: Reference to User (Site Engineer) who raised the request. (Relationship: User 1:N PermitToWork)

supervisorId.description: Reference to User (Supervisor) who reviewed the request. (Relationship: User 1:N PermitToWork)

adminId.description: Reference to User (Admin) who approved/rejected the request. (Relationship: User 1:N PermitToWork)

latitude.description: The latitude of the user when submitting the request.

longitude.description: The longitude of the user when submitting the request.

userId.description: The ID of the user this notification is for.

link.description: A URL to navigate to when the notification is clicked.

read.description: Whether the user has read the notification.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the notification was created.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to support the PermitFlow application's core features, including user management, project/site management, and Permit to Work (PtW) request workflows. Authorization Independence is achieved by denormalizing project membership into the user documents ('assignedProjectIds') and storing user roles directly on the user document. This allows for clear and secure rule logic. Structural Segregation is implemented by separating user-related data into `/users/{userId}` and PtW data into `/permits_to_work/{permitId}`, ensuring homogeneous security postures. Access Modeling employs path-based ownership for user data and role-based access control, validated by reading the user's document within security rules. Explicit state modeling is used for PtW status, and predictable schemas are enforced for data clarity. The structure supports QAPs by allowing listing of permits and users based on assigned roles.
